cmd.name: tusmulas
cmd.description: Calls the nearest free food wagons to follow the hero until it carries 2001 food. If that isn't enough, the nearest settlements send 500-food wagons.

cmd.name: tusmulas_auto
cmd.description: Turns automatic mode on or off for this hero: when the wagons following it carry less than 1000 food, it gathers wagons again on its own (at most every 30 seconds).
